idea-plugin.name: Kiro with GUI
idea-plugin.description:
A rich GUI plugin that integrates Kiro CLI into JetBrains IDEs.

Chat with Kiro directly inside your IDE through a JCEF-based chat interface with Markdown rendering, code highlighting, and multi-session tabs.

Features

  • Chat UI — Embedded chat with Markdown/code rendering, multi-tab sessions, model selection
  • IDE Context — Send editor selections, insert @File#Line references, share diagnostics
  • Diff Viewer — Review file changes proposed by Kiro using the IDE's built-in diff viewer
  • MCP Server Management — View, add, remove, and toggle MCP servers from mcp.json
  • Skills & Agent Management — Browse available tools, switch or create agents
  • Multi-language — Korean and English UI support

Requirements

  • JetBrains IDE 2025.1+
  • kiro-cli installed and authenticated
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.4

  • Fix: Chat responses now arrive in Remote Development environments — the response stream (SSE) could not pass the remote forwarding layer, so it was replaced with lightweight polling that works both locally and remotely
  • Fix: Spinner animations (e.g. the "Opening browser..." login prompt when signed out) no longer flood the system log — repeated frames are collapsed into a single line
  • The message input stays editable while a response is generating, so you can pre-type your next message
  • Model lists are now synced with kiro-cli (--list-models) instead of being hardcoded — fetched once in the background and cached, so nothing gets slower

0.2.3

  • Fix: Windows absolute paths (C:\...) are now recognized when setting the kiro-cli path — no more false "kiro-cli not found" warning and no need for the \-prefix workaround
  • Fix: PATH environment for spawned processes now uses the platform path separator (; on Windows)

0.2.2

  • Fix: NoSuchMethodError: LafManager.removeLafManagerListener on 2026.2 EAP (build 262+) — theme listener now uses the message bus API
  • Fix: Chat could stop responding after SSE reconnections (e.g. Remote Development) due to backend thread pool exhaustion and a stream writer race

0.2.1

  • Light theme support — Chat panel now supports light theme with new Auto/Light/Dark setting (Auto follows IDE theme)
  • English by default — Default UI language is now English (Korean still available in Settings)
  • Theme changes apply immediately without IDE restart
  • Translated remaining hardcoded Korean strings (slash command descriptions, error messages, button tooltips)

0.1.1

  • Fix: Chat UI now loaded via /ui endpoint so JCEF can make same-origin fetch/SSE requests

0.1.0

  • Initial release
  • JCEF-based chat UI with Markdown rendering and code highlighting
  • Multi-session tab support
  • IDE context sharing (selection, file references, diagnostics)
  • Diff viewer integration for file change proposals
  • MCP server management panel
  • Skills and Agent management
  • Automatic PATH resolution for macOS GUI environments
  • Korean and English localization
